metadata.description: A curated collection of plugins for Claude Code and Tanzu Platform

plugins.name: supplychain-motivator
plugins.description: Supply chain status and motivation. ALWAYS activate when 'supply chain' appears anywhere in the user's request — including 'current supply chain', 'check supply chain', 'supply chain status', 'motivate supply chain', or any other mention. Checks the daily target and generates a status report with team motivation.

plugins.name: factory-audit
plugins.description: Audit factory applications for memory compliance in org dekt-org-group. Flags apps over 1GB and recommends reducing memory.

plugins.name: google-chat-poster
plugins.description: Post messages or results to a Google Chat space. ALWAYS activate when the user says 'post to Google chat', 'post results to Google chat', 'post all results to Google chat', or mentions 'Google chat' as a destination for output. In multi-task prompts, aggregates results from all completed tasks into a single formatted message. IMPORTANT: Must actually execute the curl or python3 command and verify a 200 HTTP response — never claim the message was sent without running the command.
keywords: post all results to Google chat

plugins.name: mailgun
plugins.description: Send emails via Mailgun API. Use when the user requests to send an email, notify someone via email, or compose and deliver email messages to recipients.
